A thief should never be seen or

If you can throw or kick sand

scripts.translation: 不仅能降低对方的防御，

scripts.text: but their ability to attack is impaired.
scripts.translation: 还会削弱对方的攻击能力。

scripts.text: It is so effective, you may even stun them.
scripts.translation: 效果非常好，甚至能让对方陷入昏迷。
